title: Maharashtra resident doctors call for indefinite hunger strike over state registration to homoeopathy practitioners
summary: Resident doctors in Maharashtra have begun an indefinite hunger strike to demand recognition of homeopathic practitioners. The strike started on [date] after the government refused to register homeopathic practitioners, citing lack of scientific evidence. The doctors claim that their profession is being unfairly targeted by the government. The strike has been called off for now, but the doctors are planning to continue their protest if their demands are not met.
summary_points: Resident doctors in Maharashtra began an indefinite hunger strike on [date] over state registration to homoeopathy practitioners
The strike was called after the government refused to register homeopathic practitioners, citing lack of scientific evidence
The doctors claim that their profession is being unfairly targeted by the government
The strike has been temporarily suspended, but the doctors are planning to continue their protest if their demands are not met

center: Dainik Bhaskar reported that the resident doctors have been protesting for several days over the issue of state registration to homoeopathy practitioners.
The outlet stated that the doctors are demanding recognition of their profession, but did not provide further details on their demands.
Amar Ujala reported that the government's decision has been met with opposition from the resident doctors, who claim that it is unfair and discriminatory.
